[SWS_DM_00239]
Aging
counter
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04133
⌈
The DM shall support an
Aging
counter for each
event memory
entry.
⌋
Note that this counter shall be available as
internal data element
of extended
data records.
The implementation of the internal aging counter mechanism is independent
from the configuration parameter
DiagnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.
dataProvider
of the corresponding
DiagnosticEdrDataProviderMap-
ping.extendedDataRecordElement
set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT
or to
DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT
. Only for reading the
internal data element
, a
mapping as defined in [SWS_DM_00956] and [SWS_DM_00957] is applied.
